_how: Flavor Connections (added 16 Nov 2026). One puzzle per date (Nairobi time). Each puzzle has 4 groups, easiest first (the order sets the colour: yellow, green, blue, purple). Each group: t (the link, shown once solved), w (exactly 4 tiles, CAPS, no tile used twice in a puzzle), x (one line shown on the results screen), s (optional story slug for 'Read our story'). A tile may look like it fits two groups (a red herring), but only one way of splitting the 16 can be right. Every fact checked against 2+ sources before it goes in. A day with no puzzle hides the card on Today.
